product.provider: NASA GMAO GEOS-CF v2 via NCCS
product.definition: Hourly interval averages in the bottom model layer (72), on a 0.25-degree grid. PM at RH 35% includes water; gases are dry-air mole fractions converted to ppb. Not AQI, smoke-only, monitor readings, personal exposure, or regulatory guidance.

comparison.limitations: Diagnostic differences between matching hourly NASA ozone means and preliminary AirNow concentrations, both in ppb. NASA is a regional surface-layer dry-air mixing ratio; monitor sampling and moisture basis may differ. Grid and instrument locations differ. Negative monitor values are retained with their source flags. Collection lead and model-run lead are separate. This small, on-demand sample is not calibrated accuracy, a regulatory evaluation, personal exposure or evidence that one model is generally better. Revised observations can change these differences.
